result.markdown:
If you want to sell AI phone agents to businesses under **your own company name, logo, and domain**, there are several white-label platforms worth considering in 2026. The key is to choose one that lets you control client pricing and recurring billing, not merely one that lets you build AI voice agents.

## My top 5 white-label AI voice agent platforms

![The Voice Operating Layer | Trillet](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/CfWi8yVX6kQfSRVlBHGvpQUPI18wM3SmspLij3WdDPbNhoct5CiSQY9qaTSIYXfzSTdHOF-yJknm69YUhl2RaFlAeWStytKcW7kPVDO7glmtsRKxaIvKNjHCFdM4xKvFLowUpnT-jpv_qsxG89h0gfOMYFxHk2pgNHIYN5CumAFwkZCo78xbZd0UQnNcQ0yM?purpose=fullsize)

## 1\. Trillet

(Best all-around starting point)

**Best for\:** Agencies wanting a ready-made, branded voice AI business.

- Custom branding and domain
- Separate workspaces for clients
- Stripe billing and the ability to mark up usage
- Voice, SMS, email and chat capabilities

Reported plans: \$99/month for Studio and \$299/month for Agency, with different workspace and usage allowances. Confirm current terms before subscribing. ## 5\. OnDial

**Best for\:** A managed, business-focused reseller solution.

- Your brand, domain and pricing
- Client subaccounts and a partner dashboard
- No-code agent configuration
- Vendor-managed infrastructure and support

OnDial advertises security and compliance capabilities for enterprise use. Ask for a quote and verify certifications, contractual coverage and usage pricing before choosing it. [www.ondial.ai](https://www.ondial.ai/white-label-ai-voice-agent?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## Which one would I choose?

| If your priority is… | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| Start with a smaller budget | Trillet Studio — \$99/month |
| Full branded portal and billing | Trillet Agency — \$299/month |
| Predictable bundled calling costs | Autocalls — \$419/month for full white label |
| More technical control over providers | VoiceAIWrapper |
| Sell a complete CRM and AI automation package | HighLevel |


The pricing and features above are based on published vendor information and current comparison pages. **My recommendation\:** Start by comparing Trillet and Autocalls. Trillet has a lower entry price, while Autocalls' full white-label plan includes more calling minutes and a bundled usage rate. Compare the actual costs at your expected call volume before deciding.

- [Trillet official white-label pricing](https://trillet.ai/whitelabel/pricing)
- [Autocalls official white-label pricing](https://autocalls.ai/white-label)

One important distinction: make sure you are purchasing the **agency white-label/reseller plan**, not a regular AI receptionist subscription. The latter may only cover your own business and may not give you the right to resell accounts under your brand. The best choice depends on how hands-on you want to be. Do you want to **build and configure the AI agents yourself**, or would you prefer a provider that handles most of the technical work while you focus on sales and clients?
